q: Tell me about Smart Doc Finder
a:
**Project: Smart Doc Finder**
Smart Doc Finder is built with Python · Redis (Streams + Vector DB + Semantic Cache) · MongoDB · React · Docker. Keyword search has one fatal flaw: you have to remember exactly how something was worded to find it. That's not how memory works, and it's not how understanding works either. Smart Doc Finder watches your document directory in real time via Redis Streams, chunks anything large into contextual blocks, embeds every chunk into Redis Vector Search, and checks a semantic cache before it even runs a query, so if someone asked something similar recently, it returns instantly.
